title: Dallas Cowboys vs. New York Giants Postgame Analysis: What Happened, What We Got Right and What We Learned
seo_title: Dallas Cowboys 20-28 New York Giants: EdgeDesk Postgame Thesis Audit
excerpt: New York Giants won 28-20. The number landed, and some of the reasoning behind it held up. Take the result; do not take it as confirmation of the parts that did not.
seo_description: New York Giants beat Dallas Cowboys 28-20. EdgeDesk’s number implied New York Giants +3 — win. 6 of 11 gradeable claims held up, 3 did not. Process grade: MIXED. Research, not picks.
model_status_note: The number landed, and some of the reasoning behind it held up. Take the result; do not take it as confirmation of the parts that did not.
author: EdgeDesk Research
research_source: Ratings: EdgeDesk’s NFL rating state — trained seeds through 2025 plus 2 absorbed 2026 games, opponent-adjusted from the public nflverse team-week feed. Projection: the same edgedesk_football_v1.0.0 call the game card makes. Nothing on this page was computed in your browser twice.

tally.headline: 6 of 11 gradeable claims held up, 3 did not

implied_side.why: EdgeDesk’s own number sat 5.5 points toward New York Giants of the quote EdgeDesk captured at nflverse reference. That is what the disagreement implied. It was published as research, not as a recommendation to bet it.

implied_total.why: EdgeDesk’s fair total of 48 sat 0.5 points below the captured total of 48.5.

closing_line.note: The line did not move between the captured quote and the close.

reasons: 4 claims held up, 2 held up in direction only and 3 did not. Parts of the read were right and parts were not.
EdgeDesk projected a home margin of 2.5 and the game finished 8 the home way — 5.5 points of margin error, inside the range the model published.
process.basis: the drivers, matchups and measured advantages only — never the price or the market claim, which are the result in longer words

verdict.line: The number landed, and some of the reasoning behind it held up. Take the result; do not take it as confirmation of the parts that did not.

grading.separation_note: The bet result and the process grade above are computed separately and are allowed to disagree. A winning number with a broken thesis is recorded as exactly that.

lessons.lesson: EdgeDesk prices these games partly on signals it has no way to observe afterwards. That is not an error in the model — it is a gap in the audit, and it means the platform cannot tell, from results alone, whether those parts of the number are earning their weight.
